project.title: Americo Paredes Interviews
project.description:
This project features biographical interviews with Dr. Americo Paredes captured between 1994-1995. The interviews are part of the Los Del Valle Oral History Project Archive held at the Nettie Lee Benson Latin American Collection at The University of Texas at Austin.

Financing and technical support for the project was provided by the  AVAnnotate  Mellon Foundation funded project.
project.creator: llilasbenson
